title: melampyrum lineare var. americanum
intro: Melampyrum lineare var. americanum, commonly known as American cow wheat, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Orobanchaceae. This plant is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Melampyrum lineare var. americanum include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and promote the expulsion of mucus from the airways. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
